verdict: Paid ads delivered a strong week; local search has gone dark.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Meta campaigns returned a 4.81 return on ad spend — up 6.79% week-over-week — and purchases jumped 50% in the most recent seven days, led by the Muslim Subscription Box campaign. The concern this week is your Google Business Profile: actions dropped to zero for four consecutive days (August 2–5), against a prior daily average of roughly 16, meaning local search is not driving calls, directions, or website visits the way it was. We are investigating the cause and working to restore that visibility now. Instagram reach also softened to its lowest point in 45 days, which we are monitoring alongside the GBP situation. Expect an update on local search status before the next weekly report.

highlights.phrase: Return on ad spend in the last 28 days, up from last week
Purchase growth week-over-week on Meta ads
Google Business Profile actions recorded in the last 28 days — but zero in the last four days

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile has shown zero actions for four straight days, cutting off local search traffic — calls, directions, and website clicks from search.
watch_item.fix: The cause is being investigated now and restoring local search visibility is the top priority this week.
